name: FEVEROUS: Fact Verification Over Structured and Unstructured Information
description: FEVEROUS is a fact verification benchmark consisting of 87,026 human-written claims verified against evidence combining both structured (Wikipedia tables) and unstructured (Wikipedia text sentences) knowledge.

source_references.title: FEVEROUS: Fact Extraction and VERification Over Unstructured and Structured information

verification.notes: Verified against NeurIPS 2021 publication (arXiv: 2106.05707) and fever.ai dataset distribution. Contains exactly 87,026 claims (train: 71,291, dev: 7,890, test: 7,845) classified as SUPPORTS, REFUTES, or NOT ENOUGH INFO.

size.notes: JSONL claims and SQLite Wikipedia reference dump.
